_comment: GBP Posts plan Phase 6's location mapping - the ONLY source publish_gbp_post.py (and,
at approval time, the GBP approval wrapper) may resolve accountId/locationId from.
`version` is an immutable revision number a human bumps whenever this file's content
materially changes - this, not a live 'last-verified timestamp', is what gets hashed
into an approval's payload-hash chain (a routine re-verification naturally bumps a
timestamp, which would invalidate every prior approval if that were hashed instead).
v2 (2026-09-03): place_id filled in for both locations - confirmed by the operator
against their own Google Business Profile dashboard (both listings show 'Verified'
status there, matching name and address exactly) after a live DataForSEO Maps lookup
surfaced both as candidates. This does NOT complete Phase 0 - 'verified' stays false
and account_id/location_id stay null until the Business Profile API pairing (Phase 0
items 2-4: Google Cloud project, OAuth scope, and the one-time human-verified pairing
between this place_id and the Business Profile API's own accountId/locationId for the
SAME physical location) is done. gbp_publish_state.resolve_locked_target refuses any
entry whose 'verified' is not literally True, so this partial fill unlocks nothing.
Every entry below is 'verified': false, because Phase 0 (a Google Cloud project with the
posting-capable API enabled, an OAuth token with the right scope, and the one-time
human-verified pairing between DataForSEO's place_id/cid and the Business Profile API's
own accountId/locationId for the SAME physical location) has not happened yet - see
projects/art/loops/gbp/spec.md's Phase 0 section. Nothing in this workspace may invent
or derive account_id/location_id; a human sets 'verified': true and fills those in only
after performing that verification for real.
UNC Campus and Thornton are STRUCTURALLY ABSENT from this file, not merely unlisted as
an oversight - UNC Campus is footer-only (never a real GBP profile, per gbp-profiles.md)
and Thornton is a closed former location (per art.yaml). Never add either here.
